display-en.purpose: Hero h1 in Inter 800, white over the photo hero; the loudest voice.

display-zh.purpose: Chinese display headings in Noto Serif TC 700 — the literary-serif counterpart of any display heading.

headline.purpose: Section h2 in Inter 700; use text-wrap: balance.

title.purpose: Card / feature h3 headings in Inter 600, jade-dark or ink.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, Inter 1rem/1.7, Ink; cap measure 65-75ch. rem-based so the reading-size control scales it.

eyebrow.purpose: Deliberate section kicker; uppercase, 0.18em. Deep jade on light, light mint on dark bands. Two homepage kickers only.

shadows.name: header-condensed
shadows.purpose: Sticky header once scrolled; pairs with backdrop-blur (built — Tailwind shadow-md).

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Recommended barely-there warm shadow on cards (flat as built; gentle layering is the target).

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Recommended soft warm hover shadow with translateY(-2px). Ink-tinted, never neutral black.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal fade + rise + settle ([data-reveal]); the signature easing.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Default duration for color/border/filter hover transitions.

motion.name: btn-sheen
motion.purpose: Specular highlight: 0.7s hover sweep on every gold button (::after); 5s passive shimmer loop on marquee Enroll CTAs only (.btn-shimmer ::before). Gated behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The CTA. A metallic gold-gradient fill with ink text (never white — white-on-gold fails AA); a specular sheen sweeps across on hover. Works on light surfaces and dark green bands alike.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: inline-block; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E6BC4E 0%, #D8A832 50%, #C28F22 100%); color: #221F1A; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; transition: filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 55%; background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.6) 50%, transparent 100%); transform: translateX(-200%) skewX(-18deg); pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.94); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::after { transition: transform 0.7s ease; transform: translateX(320%) skewX(-18deg); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D8A832; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary CTA on photo / dark green bands only; white border and label.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.7); border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D8A832; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Flat paper card with a 1px warm border and the one deliberate 5px jade top-rule. The top-rule marks a feature card (homepage value-props + Programs offerings) only — never propagated as card grammar.
components.html:
WASC-Accredited

A credentialed high-school credit track, recognized since 1972.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ECE6D6; border: 1px solid #D9D0C0; border-top: 5px solid #1A6E52; border-radius: 10px; padding: 28px; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #C8B89A; } .ds-card-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; background: #E6F3EE; color: #134B38; } .ds-card-title { margin: 20px 0 0; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: #134B38; } .ds-card-body { margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #57534A; }

components.name: Header Nav Link
components.description: Uppercase tracked white nav link on the sticky jade header; active link is cream + underline with aria-current.
components.html: ProgramsEnrollAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; background: #1A6E52; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-nav-link { color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; padding: 8px 12px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #ECE6D6; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #ECE6D6; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D8A832; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Deliberate section kicker; uppercase, wide-tracked. Deep jade on light surfaces (dark-band call sites override to light mint). Two homepage kickers only — never above every section.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0E5038; margin: 0; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Pill status/category tag. Green tint for status, gold tint for category, ink for dark. Small (10-11px). The 'NEW' electives badge is a gold fill with ink text.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 100px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-badge-green { background: #D6EDD9; color: #1E4D25; } .ds-badge-gold { background: #FEF3DC; color: #7A5500; }

narrative.overview: A fifty-year institution that has been tastefully renovated. The bones are old and proud — a WASC-accredited school running since 1972 — but the surfaces are current, composed, and confident. The palette is jade green and gold over a warm paper field: a jade green carries the structure, gold is the one warm voice that asks for action (CTAs), and the body is a warm paper that reads as ink-on-paper rather than a generic near-white. Traditional Chinese is set in Noto Serif TC, a literary serif that signals heritage and gravity; English and all UI runs in Inter, which keeps the structure modern and clean. The two together are the whole idea: heritage and modernity in one composed room. The mood is warm but editorial. Headings are large, extrabold, and tightly tracked (-0.03em); sections are generously spaced and separated by tonal background bands (paper -> mint -> deep jade -> jade) rather than by chrome. Corners are sharp and structured (6-12px, never pills); surfaces are flat and bordered, not shadowed. Gold is the one place the system raises its voice — a metallic CTA fill with a quiet sheen. This system explicitly rejects the dated, cluttered Joomla site it replaces; cold corporate / SaaS clichés; anything childish or cartoonish; and stuffy, institutional dryness.
keyCharacteristics: Earthy, rooted palette: jade green + gold over warm paper. Gold is the CTA; green accents do the labelling.
Bilingual type as identity: Noto Serif TC (中文, literary serif) paired with Inter (EN + all UI).
Editorial headings: extrabold, large (up to ~4.5rem), tightly tracked (-0.03em).
Sharp, structured geometry: 6-12px radii, flat bordered surfaces, tonal section bands.
Gold-fill CTAs with a specular sheen; jade/mint accent text; pill badges as the badge system.
Global gold focus-visible ring; all motion (sheen, reveals, parallax, splash) degrades under reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Gold-Is-CTA Rule
rules.body: Gold = interactive action (button fills, focus ring, 'NEW'). It is not used as accent label text. A gold fill is always paired with ink text, never white.

rules.name: The Green-Accent-Text Rule
rules.body: Accent/label text is green: deep jade #0E5038 on light surfaces, light mint #6FC9A0 on dark green bands. Do not use a mid/bright jade as small text on a dark green band — it fails AA. The accent must be light enough (mint) on dark, dark enough (deep jade) on light.

rules.name: The Paper-Is-The-Field Rule
rules.body: Paper (#ECE6D6) is the ground; greens and ink are the figure. Color carries through accents, bands, and imagery — not by tinting the body warmer.

rules.name: The Warm-Black Rule
rules.body: All dark text/surfaces use Ink (#221F1A), never pure #000.

rules.name: The No-Stray-Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is not in the palette. The only blues allowed are external brand marks (Facebook #1877F2, Google Calendar #4285F4). Everything else is jade/gold/ink.

rules.name: The Two-Script Rule
rules.body: Chinese is always Noto Serif TC; English/UI is always Inter. The script is the cue for which face to use.

rules.name: The Eyebrow-Restraint Rule
rules.body: The eyebrow is a deliberate kicker, not a per-section reflex. It appears in exactly two places: the homepage features and culture section headers. Interior pages do not carry a header eyebrow. Do not reintroduce a kicker above every page heading; that's AI scaffolding, not voice.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest — paper or tonal bands, structure from 1px warm borders and background-color changes. The only shadow in play is the sticky header's shadow-md once scrolled. Card hover changes border color, not elevation.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If shadows are added, they are tinted with Ink (rgba(34,31,26,…)), diffuse, and low-opacity. Crisp or neutral-black shadows are forbidden.

rules.name: The Feature-Card-Top-Rule Rule
rules.body: A 5px jade top border marks a feature card — homepage value-props and Programs offering cards only. It is NOT card grammar: resource lists, callouts, info boxes, and class grids get a plain 1px border.

dos: Do use gold for CTAs only — button fills (always ink text), focus ring, 'NEW' (Gold-Is-CTA).
Do make accent text green: deep jade (#0E5038) on light, light mint (#6FC9A0) on dark.
Do set Chinese in Noto Serif TC and English/UI in Inter, always (Two-Script Rule).
Do use Ink (#221F1A) for primary body copy; Ink-Soft for secondary.
Do keep paper as the field; carry warmth through accents, bands, and imagery (Paper-Is-The-Field).
Do reserve the 5px jade top-rule for feature cards (homepage values + Programs offerings).
Do keep the eyebrow to the two homepage section kickers only.
Do test every heading and CTA in both EN (Inter) and 中文 (Noto Serif TC) at every breakpoint.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion fallback to static, visible content.
Do verify any accent/green text hits AA (4.5:1 small, 3:1 large) before shipping.
donts: Don't put white text on a gold fill — gold is light; use ink (white-on-gold fails AA).
Don't use gold as accent label text, or a bright/mid jade as small text on dark green — both fail AA.
Don't add colored side/edge stripes (border-left/right > 1px) to any card/callout — absolute ban.
Don't stamp an eyebrow above every section/page — it's AI scaffolding (two homepage kickers only).
Don't propagate the top-rule beyond feature cards — it's a marker, not card grammar.
Don't reintroduce blue (except the Facebook / Google-Calendar external brand marks).
Don't use pure black (#000) for text or shadows — Ink only (Warm-Black Rule).
Don't use pills for buttons — geometry is sharp (6px).
Don't rebuild the Joomla clutter, drift to SaaS clichés, go childish, or go stuffy.
